# Archival sources on post-war migration (fixture, distractor)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

The collection documents recruitment agreements and the arrival of workers in the
post-war period. The finding aid lists correspondence, administrative files and press
clippings. It contains no statistics and makes no claims about crime or employment
levels.
